logsquirl_tcpdump_log.title: tcpdump / pcap Viewer packet list
logsquirl_tcpdump_log.description: The packet list the tcpdump / pcap Viewer plugin converts a capture to: one line per packet with its number, stream, UTC time, time since the first packet, source, destination, protocol, length on the wire and info. Either time column may be left out in the plugin's configuration, and is empty then; MAC columns the configuration adds start the info.

number.description: The packet's number in the capture, from 1 (a string, so that the Chart Panel does not offer it as a value)

stream.description: The TCP or UDP stream number, counted per transport; - for a packet without one, ? past the stream cap

time.description: Seconds since the first packet of the capture, negative for an earlier one; empty when the plugin is configured to show the UTC time only

source.description: The source IP address, or MAC address without one; - for neither. With host names shown, an address a DNS answer earlier in the capture named carries the name behind it: 93.184.216.34(example.com)

destination.description: The destination IP address, or MAC address without one; - for neither. With host names shown, an address a DNS answer earlier in the capture named carries the name behind it: 93.184.216.34(example.com)

protocol.description: The highest protocol recognised in the packet

length.description: The packet's length on the wire, in bytes
